provenanceNote: The raw per-package output of this scan does not exist. It was written to scan-results-*.json at the repository root, which matched a line in .gitignore, so it was never committed; it was searched for on 2026-07-27 across local disk, all 13 connected GitHub organisations and GitHub code search, and found nowhere. The aggregate survived because it was committed, and survived twice over: in data/corpus/corpus-2026-03-18.json and in the CC-BY-4.0 scan summary served at census.cryptoserve.dev/data/scan-summary-2026-03.json. The two agree exactly. This dataset is published as aggregate-only for that reason, and it is why the scan pipeline now persists raw output as a build artifact and fails when it produces nothing.
note: Aggregate counts of packages examined per ecosystem and how they classify across the weak, modern and PQC tiers. Two ecosystems carry a knownIssue recording a defect in the scanner that produced their row; the figures are annotated rather than edited, because a published corpus is dated evidence. See knownIssues.
